title: It's Saturday (both in 2025 and in 1890) so it's time to see how Wynona's week was
excerpt: It's Saturday (both in 2025 and in 1890) so it's time to see how Wynona's week was. Dec. 7. Uncle and Aunt went to meeting. I stayed home had company. Got much colder towards evening. E. and I went to the Level, then came to Uncle Wills. Ex
